proposal.title: Creation of Executive Wallet
proposal.description:
Initial tests have shown that neither SimpleSwap nor Binance can receive deposits from the Liquidity Initiatives DAO wallet directly. I am proposing to initially fund a secodary executive wallet owned by LuncGoblins/Frag to be able to carry out the swaps necessary to acquire USDC. This funding request will send 1,000,000 LUNC to the wallet `terra1r7dfa0gkngsqv0lxfl297s9sh2zat4xupq9g23` to register the wallet in the blockchain state. This wallet shall never contain more than $2000 worth of assets under single management. This aligns with the guidelines initially proposed and passed in proposal 12171 on Terra Classic.

YES - Fund a secondary wallet and carry out the swaps from there
NO - Do not fund a secondary wallet. Terra Classic Governance needs to be consulted.

proposal.title: Increase GRDX Allowance
proposal.description:
1. Providing **initial liquidity** for the LUNC/USDC pair on Garuda Defi will incur a **1.5k GRDX fee**
2. Garuda **team sent 1.5k GRDX** to the treasury of this multisig DAO to cover it (see https://finder.terraclassic.community/mainnet/tx/500EE4D6BE0DDA4E880AF654A08AF3BA541E3122EC74E5423F21611F40B7C947)
3. When providing the liquidity the **DEX needs allowance** to pay the fee
4. This proposal will **increase the allowance to 1.5k**, spendable by the DEX's fee collector
